{{Quote|I do enjoy visiting the Adventurers' Guildhall. It's still quite new to Aurilia, but we expect it to thrive and grow in the coming years. Anyone seeking adventure should visit the guildhall from time to time. You shall most assuredly find that which you seek.|[[Rohak]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Rohak's Figurines|Dathomir}}</ref>}}
The '''Adventurers' Guildhall''' was a building in the township of [[Aurilia]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was built after the reconstruction of the village, following the [[battle of Aurilia]],<ref name="SWG:A" /> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> It was a meeting place for spacers seeking adventure.<ref name="SWG:RF" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], various representatives of several factions, including the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]],<ref name="SWG:LSD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Lost Star Destroyer|Dathomir}}</ref> and the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]], visited the guildhall hoping to hire experienced adventurers and [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] for dangerous missions.<ref name="SWG:NS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Nym's Slicer|Dathomir}}</ref> These representatives included [[Hirael Chindiaye]], Imperial [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Appleton]],<ref name="SWG:LSD" /> [[Nym's Envoy]],<ref name="SWG:NS" /> and a [[Unidentified Corellia University teaching assistant|Corellia University teaching assistant]].<ref name="SWG:CS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Controlling Spirit|Talus}}</ref>

Many heroic events that took place all around the galaxy indirectly began at the guildhall, including the [[Tusken Raider Invasion of Mos Espa]], the the thwarted escape of [[Axkva Min]] from the [[Chamber of Banishment]], the [[Battle of Nym's Factory Compound]],<ref name="SWG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref> the [[Retaking of the Blackguard|capture]] of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Blackguard (Star Destroyer)|''Blackguard'']],<ref name="SWG:C8">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis}}</ref> and the defeat of the [[Cult of Exar Kun]].<ref name="SWG:C9">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Adventurers' Guildhall appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:A" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Adventurers' Guildhall was added to the game along with the revamped city of [[W:c:swg:Aurilia|Aurilia]],<ref name="SWG:A" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|Chapter 7]]" update on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref>
